verdict.rationale: Graphite's pricing page lists an 'Automations' feature. The docs show one event-triggered behavior: Graphite Agent automatically reviews every new pull request in the repositories you select. Nothing in the pack describes how users define rule conditions, choose trigger events, or pick actions. The custom AI-review rules and inbox filter rules are adjacent features, not event-action automation. Missing for 10: documentation of a user-defined rule builder, the supported trigger events and available actions, configuration examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Graphite Agent will now automatically review all new pull requests in the selected repositories
